title: Ten minutes is a complete session. Nobody told you that.
caption: Is a 10 minute workout enough? Ten minutes is a complete session, not a warm-up for one that never comes: Half Squat, Wall Slide, Standing Hip Hinge, Incline Push-Up, Knee Plank, two rounds. Save this for your next ten minutes.

overlays.text: Ten minutes is a complete session. Nobody told you that.

scenes.footer: The ten minutes is the workout.

overlays.text: Ten minutes is not a warm-up for a real workout that never comes.

scenes.footer: Two rounds, with room to breathe between them.

overlays.text: Squat, pull, hinge, push, core. All five patterns fit in ten minutes.

scenes.footer: The hour keeps moving. The ten minutes are already here.

overlays.text: The ten minutes you do beats the hour you plan.

scenes.footer: Short is not lesser. Ten minutes is complete.

overlays.text: Ten minutes today and ten tomorrow is strength you build and keep.

scenes.footer: Two rounds. About ten minutes. One chair, one wall.

overlays.text: Half Squat 10, Wall Slide 10, Standing Hip Hinge 10, Incline Push-Up 8, Knee Plank 25s.

scenes.footer: Save this for your next ten minutes.

overlays.text: When will your ten minutes be?
